Vaswani2017Attention.title: Attention Is All You Need
Vaswani2017Attention.abstract: Introduces the Transformer, a sequence model built entirely from attention without recurrence or convolution.

Tay2022Efficient.title: Efficient Transformers: A Survey
Tay2022Efficient.abstract: Surveys efficient Transformer architectures and organizes their trade-offs in compute, memory, and accuracy.

Kaplan2020Scaling.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
Kaplan2020Scaling.abstract: Empirical scaling laws relating model size, data, compute, and language-modeling loss.

Child2019Generating.title: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers
Child2019Generating.abstract: Introduces fixed sparse attention patterns that scale Transformers to long sequences.

Beltagy2020Longformer.title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
Beltagy2020Longformer.abstract: Combines sliding-window attention with task-specific global attention for long documents.

Zaheer2020Big.title: Big Bird: Transformers for Longer Sequences
Zaheer2020Big.abstract: Sparse attention with global tokens plus theoretical guarantees for long sequences.

Kitaev2020Reformer.title: Reformer: The Efficient Transformer
Kitaev2020Reformer.abstract: Uses locality-sensitive hashing and reversible layers to reduce Transformer memory.

Wang2020Linformer.title: Linformer: Self-Attention with Linear Complexity
Wang2020Linformer.abstract: Projects keys and values to a low-rank space to obtain linear-time self-attention.

Rae2020Compressive.title: Compressive Transformers for Long-Range Sequence Modelling
Rae2020Compressive.abstract: Keeps a compressed memory of past activations to extend the effective context.

Graves2016Adaptive.title: Adaptive Computation Time for Recurrent Neural Networks
Graves2016Adaptive.abstract: Learns per-step halting so recurrent networks can spend variable computation.

Jang2017Categorical.title: Categorical Reparameterization with Gumbel-Softmax
Jang2017Categorical.abstract: Gumbel-Softmax gives a differentiable approximation to sampling categorical variables.

Loshchilov2019Decoupled.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
Loshchilov2019Decoupled.abstract: Decouples weight decay from adaptive gradient updates, yielding the AdamW optimizer.
